comment: Kernels whose Linux-Kernel_MiSTer commit is pinned (by the id of their /proc/version: the first 16 hex digits of its SHA-256) instead of found by find-commit.sh. Needed only when find-commit.sh cannot tell the commit (a kernel built from a commit pushed later with an older date, or from another branch). The first entry records the mapping checked by hand for linux_release_20260912.
